definition: the order my needs drop below feeling as capacity falls, and come back as it returns

settled:
Capacity decides which of my needs I can feel at all. Below a level, a need stops arriving rather than going unmet quietly.

They go quiet and come back in order of what they cost. People have always been my most expensive tier, so anything I need from people is the first to go and the last to return.

At the deepest lows even hunger, thirst and needing the bathroom dropped below feeling.

So a need getting louder as I recover is a real gap becoming feelable rather than a new problem appearing.

I do not expect more tiers underneath. Connection is the last one, and I have met no other need of the same necessity.
